Common questions in Mornington Peninsula

How much does a wedding photographer cost in Mornington Peninsula?
What a wedding photographer costs in Mornington Peninsula depends on coverage hours, the number of shooters, editing and inclusions like albums or prints. Requesting quotes from photographers who cover Mornington Peninsula is the best way to see real local pricing for your day.
How many hours of coverage do I need?
Most full weddings are covered across six to ten hours, from getting ready to the reception. Shorter events and corporate functions may only need two to four hours. Tell us your run sheet and we will help match coverage to it.
Do photographers who cover Mornington Peninsula travel to my venue?
Most providers list a service area and many travel beyond it for a small fee. When you enquire, mention your Mornington Peninsula venue so they can confirm coverage and any travel costs.
How do I choose between two providers?
Start with the portfolio and the style you connect with, then compare coverage hours, inclusions and turnaround. A quick call also tells you a lot about how they will work on the day.
